<!DOCTYPE html>

<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<meta content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" name="viewport"/>
<title>MIV — Apresentação Corporativa V21</title>
<meta content="Proposta comercial MIV — Marketing, Inteligência e Vendas." name="description"/>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" rel="preconnect"/>
<link crossorigin="" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" rel="preconnect"/>
<link href="https://api.fontshare.com/v2/css?f[]=general-sans@400,500,600,700&amp;display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
<style>
    :root{
      --bg:#06080c; --bg-2:#0b0f15; --line:rgba(255,255,255,.10); --text:#f6f7f9; --muted:#a7afbb;
      --dark:#12141a; --soft:#f5f2eb; --soft-2:#ece7de; --purple:#8d25ff; --purple-2:#b76aff;
      --lime:#d0f000; --danger:#ff6767; --shadow:0 28px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.24); --shadow-soft:0 18px 42px rgba(0,0,0,.14); --glass:rgba(255,255,255,.06); --max:1240px;
    }
    *{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0;}
    html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
    body{font-family:'General Sans',system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);line-height:1.45;overflow-x:hidden;}
    img{display:block;max-width:100%;}
    a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;}
    button{font:inherit;background:none;border:none;color:inherit;cursor:pointer;}
    .wrap{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 32px;}
    .section{padding:118px 0;position:relative;}
    .section.light{background:var(--soft);color:var(--dark);}
    .section.light-2{background:var(--soft-2);color:var(--dark);}
    .section.dark-2{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0a0d13 0%, #07090d 100%);}
    .section::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:auto 0 0;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,.08), transparent);}
    .section.light::before,.section.light-2::before{background:linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(18,20,26,.08), transparent);}
    .eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--purple-2);margin-bottom:18px;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(141,37,255,.08);border:1px solid rgba(141,37,255,.14);}
    .eyebrow::before{content:'';width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--purple);box-shadow:0 0 0 6px rgba(141,37,255,.16);}
    .title-xl,.title-lg,.title-md{font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.045em;text-wrap:balance;}
    .title-xl{font-size:clamp(50px,6.7vw,98px);line-height:.9;}
    .title-lg{font-size:clamp(36px,4.25vw,68px);line-height:.98;}
    .title-md{font-size:clamp(26px,2.8vw,40px);line-height:1.05;}
    .lede{font-size:clamp(16px,1.45vw,20px);line-height:1.82;color:var(--muted);max-width:860px;text-wrap:pretty;}
    .light .lede,.light-2 .lede{color:#5f6670;}
    .accent{color:var(--purple);} .accent-lime{color:var(--lime);}
    .reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(30px);transition:opacity .8s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), transform .8s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);}
    .reveal.is-visible{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);}
    .flow-step,.compare-card,.miv-card,.scope-card,.gov-item,.case-card,.model-fee,.model-commission,.diag-card,.stat-card{transition:transform .28s ease, box-shadow .28s ease, border-color .28s ease;}
    .flow-step:hover,.compare-card:hover,.miv-card:hover,.scope-card:hover,.gov-item:hover,.case-card:hover,.model-fee:hover,.model-commission:hover,.diag-card:hover,.stat-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px); box-shadow:0 26px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.18);}
    .hero::after{content:''; position:absolute; left:0; right:0; bottom:0; height:120px; background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(6,8,12,0) 0%, rgba(6,8,12,.88) 100%); z-index:1;}
    .case-content > *{position:relative; z-index:1;}

    .stagger{transition-delay:calc(var(--i,0) * 90ms);}

    .site-header{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;z-index:60;background:transparent;border-bottom:none;}
    .site-header .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:28px;min-height:126px;}
    .brand img{height:88px;width:auto;}
    .nav-links{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:30px;color:#f3f5f8;font-size:15px;font-weight:500;text-shadow:0 2px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.35);}
    .nav-links a{position:relative;padding:8px 0;opacity:.96;}
    .nav-links a::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;bottom:-4px;width:0;height:2px;background:var(--lime);transition:.25s ease;}
    .nav-links a:hover::after{width:100%;}
    .hamburger{display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);background:rgba(8,11,16,.32);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px);position:relative;}
    .hamburger span,.hamburger::before,.hamburger::after{content:'';display:block;width:20px;height:2px;background:#fff;transition:.25s ease;position:relative;}
    .hamburger::before{position:absolute;transform:translateY(-6px);}
    .hamburger::after{position:absolute;transform:translateY(6px);}
    body.menu-open .hamburger span{opacity:0;}
    body.menu-open .hamburger::before{transform:rotate(45deg);}
    body.menu-open .hamburger::after{transform:rotate(-45deg);}
    .mobile-menu{display:none;position:absolute;left:20px;right:20px;top:104px;background:rgba(10,13,18,.96);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-radius:24px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);padding:18px;backdrop-filter:blur(12px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px);}
    .mobile-menu a{display:block;padding:14px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);color:#eef2f7;font-size:15px;}
    .mobile-menu a:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
    .mobile-menu .mobile-cta{margin-top:12px;border-bottom:none;padding:16px 18px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--lime);color:#0b0d12;font-weight:700;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 16px 34px rgba(208,240,0,.18);}
    body.menu-open .mobile-menu{display:block;}

    .hero{position:relative;min-height:100vh;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;overflow:hidden;background:#0b0f15;}
    .hero-bg{position:absolute;inset:0;background-image:url('data:image/jpeg;base64,
